<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 2:5:7">Y. B. Mets. II, 8ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>קופד דד׳</he> a golden piece resembling meat; <cite ref="Tamid 32a">Tam. 32ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 70a:8">B. Mets. 70ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 166a:2">B. Bath. 166ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ פריכא</he> broken pieces of gold (for the melting pot).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 165b:22">Ib. 165ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ אין פחות וכ׳</he> if a note has the word ‘gold’ (without any further definition), it means no less than a Denar in gold (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).
